scope: Independent read-only current P02 inline config and renderer review; blocked, no phase acceptance

providedEvidence.scope: Controlled subprocess launcher tests, not actual Docker full-stack boot

offlineReproduction.command: GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go test -json ./launcher -run TestIndependentInlineAdmissionBoundaries
offlineReproduction.explanation: Each test requires unsafe input rejection; each failed because validateCompose returned nil. Supplied ConfigDigest was correctly recalculated for each synthetic input, so this isolates admission semantics rather than an unrelated hash mismatch.

findings.issue: Interpolation outside config content remains accepted
findings.proof: Command,environment,image repository,volume target,healthcheck and extra label values accepted ${SYNTHETIC...}; subprocess inherits ambient environment and working directory, so exact body hash does not freeze interpolated values.
findings.smallestFix: Reject interpolation in all other inline-document values and use typed literal command/healthcheck; simpler still, admit only the fixed renderer inline shape with exact config argv and no optional environment or healthcheck.

findings.issue: Duplicate and malformed JSON shapes are accepted before commands
findings.proof: Duplicate content and top-level configs keys, object-shaped command, and raw invalidUTF8 content all pass validateCompose. DisallowUnknownFields does not reject duplicate keys; any-typed fields have no shape validation; UTF8 validation after JSON decode misses replacement of malformed raw bytes.
findings.smallestFix: Check raw UTF8 and duplicate decoded object keys at every depth before closed typed decoding. Restrict Command and Healthcheck shapes, or omit those options from the inline branch.

nonFindings: Renderer escapes every dollar in supplied BrokerConfig, produces deterministic JSON with no ambient interpolation in other generated values, uses exact config target/uid/gid/mode and official digest-pinned NATS image.
Decoded content limit correctly accounts for dollar pairs; raw128KiB and decoded64KiB limits tested.
Inline file sources,extra configs,duplicate refs,wrong target/uid/mode and read_only root are denied by existing tests.
StartOwned checks configured Compose5.5.1 before commands, then independently observes exact version/context/endpoint/engine before mutation.
Actual safe qualified Docker artifact separately observed file0400 uid0 gid0 and literal bytes; copied writable-layer file is documented honestly, not claimed read-only mount.
limits: No Docker/network/model/provider execution in this independent fixture. The fixture proves admission acceptance, not actual engine mutation or an exploit.
Duplicate/malformed documents may be rejected later by Compose; that does not satisfy pre-command strict admission.
Current fixed renderer output does not itself introduce these unsafe values. Gaps are in the adapter admission contract.
Native macOS/Linux/WSL acceptance and full stack health remain separate gate obligations.
